text:
- The big bin (dustbin) stands on the floor beside the table on its left side, below the table top, centred front-to-back on the table middle; only the left arm reaches over it (expert demos). Pour over the middle of the big bin, not over its front or back edge; the pour direction matters less than being over the bin. The small bin (tabletrashbin) is on the table; do not confuse the two.
- Grasp the small bin by its rim with the arm on its side. If that is the right arm, hand it to the left arm (handover to_arm=left, mode "air" keeps it upright; "table" also works).
- With the left arm: carry(arm=left, object=tabletrashbin, ref=dustbin, relation="over", height_cm=30), then pour(arm=left, direction="front", degrees=110, shake=false) (shaking can shake the small bin out of the fingers). If the carry is UNREACHABLE, first move the held bin a few cm to the left (move dx -5) and carry again at the same height; do not settle for holding it lower than in the demos.
- End state (demos): the left arm still holds the small bin up high (about 30 cm above the table) over the big bin, tipped so its contents fell into the big bin, not onto the table or floor beside it; never release it, do not put it back down.
goal: Left arm holds the small bin up high over the big bin beside the table, tipped, its contents poured into the big bin; not released.
